reuse.why: Adds a shared isHoliday used by the existing isWeekendOrHoliday and the two inline holiday checks in app.ts, though app.ts still restates isWeekend || isHoliday instead of reusing isWeekendOrHoliday.

duplication.why: The MM-DD matching is defined once and replaces two inline includes() copies; the weekend-or-holiday combination stays restated in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: The predicate lives in shared/schedules.ts with the other weekend/holiday helpers.

scope.why: Only the holiday predicate, its call sites and tests change.

maintainability.why: Small, clear single definition of a holiday match; the leftover parallel weekend-or-holiday expressions in app.ts are a minor drift risk.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every holiday check now goes through isHoliday.
